scenes.heading: Replication Fundamentals
scenes.narration: Oak & Operations. Replication Fundamentals. In this video we review 7 key concepts you need to know for the certification.

scenes.question: What are replication agents used for according to the speech?
scenes.heading: They publish content from Author to Publish, flush Dispatcher cache, and return user input from Publish to Author
scenes.body: Section 9 defines replication agents as the mechanism for publishing content from Author to Publish, flushing Dispatcher cache, and returning user input from Publish to Author.

scenes.question: In Author-to-Publish replication, what does the default replication agent do before content reaches Publish?
scenes.heading: It packages the content and places it in the replication queue
scenes.body: The speech says a publish request is passed to the default replication agent, which packages the content and places it in the replication queue.

scenes.question: Which servlet receives replicated content on Publish by default?
scenes.heading: bin/receive
scenes.body: Section 9 states that a servlet on Publish receives the content and that the default servlet is bin/receive.

scenes.question: Which data is explicitly not replicated between Author and Publish?
scenes.heading: User data such as users, groups, and profiles
scenes.body: The source explicitly says that user data such as users, groups, and profiles is not replicated between Author and Publish.

scenes.question: How does reverse replication return data from Publish to Author?
scenes.heading: The Publish agent puts data in an outbox, and Author listeners poll the outboxes
scenes.body: Section 9 says reverse replication works by having the agent on Publish place data in an outbox, while replication listeners on Author poll the outboxes.

scenes.question: What is the default state of reverse replication since AEM 6.1?
scenes.heading: It is effectively disabled by default
scenes.body: The speech says reverse replication is effectively disabled by default since AEM 6.1.

scenes.question: How is AEM Communities user-generated content handled?
scenes.heading: It is never replicated; a common store is used instead
scenes.body: Section 9 explicitly says that for AEM Communities, user-generated content is never replicated and a common store is used instead.
